title: A blow-up of ∂[[E]] is represented on the rescaled graph over every ball (supplied step 8, hypothesis (H3) of flat_limit)
statement: Let n, k ∈ ℕ, P := n + 1 + k, U, N, E ⊆ ℝ^P, ξ_N : ℝ^P → Λ_{n+1}(ℝ^P), T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), x, y ∈ ℝ^P, λ > 0, linear isometries ι : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^P and ι' : ℝ^k → ℝ^P, u : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^k, δ₁, δ₂ ∈ ℝ, s ∈ ℝ^{n+1} and t ∈ ℝ^k. Write B_r := ball(0, r), η := η_{y,λ} (dilation y λ), Γ(v) := x + ιv + ι'u(v), g(w) := λ^{−1}(u(s + λw) − t), G(w) := ιw + ι'g(w), and F' := {w ∈ ℝ^{n+1} : s + λw ∈ B_{δ₁} and Γ(s + λw) ∈ E}. Assume: (i) E is measurable and E ⊆ N; (ii) η_#T = blowUp T y λ ∈ 𝒟_n(η(U)) satisfies η_#T(ω) = ∫_{η(E)} ξ_N(y + λz)(dω(z)) dH^{n+1}(z) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(η(U)) (IsBoundaryOfRegion (blowUp T y λ) (η(E)) (z ↦ ξ_N(y + λz)); this is the conclusion of the parent's sibling blowup_region); (iii) the area formula for C¹ graphs through ι, ι' over ℝ^{n+1}: for every g̃ : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^k, every open D̃ ⊆ ℝ^{n+1} on which g̃ is C¹, every measurable Ã ⊆ D̃ and every f : ℝ^P → ℝ, ∫_{G̃(Ã)} f dH^{n+1} = ∫_Ã √det(DG̃(w)*∘DG̃(w))·f(G̃(w)) dw with G̃(w) := ιw + ι'g̃(w) (the conclusion of the parent's sibling graph_area for m := n + 1); (iv) ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0 for all v, w, and every z ∈ ℝ^P equals ιv + ι'w for some v, w; (v) u is C¹ on B_{δ₁}; (vi) N ∩ {x + ιv + ι'w : |v| < δ₁, |w| < δ₂} = Γ(B_{δ₁}); (vii) for every v ∈ B_{δ₁} and every (n+1)-covector α, α(DΓ(v)e_0, …, DΓ(v)e_n) = √det(DΓ(v)*∘DΓ(v))·ξ_N(Γ(v))(α) (e_j = EuclideanSpace.single j 1); (viii) y = x + ιs + ι't. Then F' is measurable. Moreover, let R ∈ ℝ satisfy |s| + λR < δ₁, |t| + λR < δ₂ and ball(y, λR) ⊆ U, and let ω ∈ 𝒟^n(ℝ^P) satisfy tsupport ω ⊆ ball(0, R). Then currentEval(η_#T)(ω) = ∫_{F'∩B_R} dω(G(w))(DG(w)e_0, …, DG(w)e_n) dw, integrated against Lebesgue measure on ℝ^{n+1}.
